compile_transformer_blocks_only.tooltip: Compile only transformer blocks, faster compile and less error prone

debug_compile_keys.tooltip: Print the compile keys used for torch.compile

disable_dynamic_vram.tooltip: Disable dynamic VRAM feature as it can cause issues with compile

TorchCompileModelAdvanced.name: TorchCompileModelAdvanced
TorchCompileModelAdvanced.description: Advanced torch.compile patching for diffusion models.

enabled.tooltip: None: disable, 'state': keep info for allocated memory, 'all': keep history of all alloc/free calls

context.tooltip: None: no tracebacks, 'state': tracebacks for allocated memory, 'alloc': for alloc calls, 'all': for free calls

max_entries.tooltip: Maximum number of entries to record

StartRecordCUDAMemoryHistory.name: StartRecordCUDAMemoryHistory
StartRecordCUDAMemoryHistory.description: THIS NODE ALWAYS RUNS. Starts recording CUDA memory allocation history, can be ended and saved with EndRecordCUDAMemoryHistory.

output_path: Base path for saving the CUDA memory history file, timestamp and .pt extension will be added

EndRecordCUDAMemoryHistory.name: EndRecordCUDAMemoryHistory
EndRecordCUDAMemoryHistory.description: Records CUDA memory allocation history between start and end, saves to a file that can be analyzed here: https://docs.pytorch.org/memory_viz or with VisualizeCUDAMemoryHistory node

VisualizeCUDAMemoryHistory.name: VisualizeCUDAMemoryHistory
VisualizeCUDAMemoryHistory.description: Visualizes a CUDA memory allocation history file, opens in browser

ModelMemoryUseReportPatch.name: ModelMemoryUseReportPatch
ModelMemoryUseReportPatch.description: Adds callbacks to model to report memory usage during after sampling

ModelMemoryUsageFactorOverride.name: ModelMemoryUsageFactorOverride
ModelMemoryUsageFactorOverride.description: Overrides the memory usage factor of the model during sampling.

chunks.tooltip: Number of chunks to split the feedforward activations into to reduce peak VRAM usage.

dim_threshold.tooltip: Dimension threshold above which to apply chunking.

WanChunkFeedForward.name: WanChunkFeedForward
WanChunkFeedForward.description: EXPERIMENTAL AND MAY CHANGE THE MODEL OUTPUT!! Chunks feedforward activations to reduce peak VRAM usage.

chunk_ffn.tooltip: Chunk the feedforward activations over the sequence dim to cap the (B, L, hidden) intermediate.

ffn_chunks.tooltip: Number of chunks to split the feedforward sequence into. More chunks = lower peak, slightly more overhead.

ffn_seq_threshold.tooltip: Only chunk when the token sequence length exceeds this (skips chunking for tiny sequences).

bf16_rope.tooltip: Apply RoPE in the input dtype instead of fp32. ~Halves RoPE activation memory; matches the HF reference dtype.

Ideogram4OptimizationsKJ.name: Ideogram4OptimizationsKJ
Ideogram4OptimizationsKJ.description: EXPERIMENTAL AND MAY CHANGE THE MODEL OUTPUT!! Reduces peak VRAM of the Ideogram4 forward. chunk_ffn splits the SwiGLU activations over the token dim; bf16_rope applies RoPE in the model dtype instead of upcasting to fp32. Both target the two largest transient tensors in the block.

input_mode.tooltip: How to configure the step plan

steps_1.tooltip: Number of P&P steps for range 1

steps_2.tooltip: Number of P&P steps for range 2

steps_1.tooltip: Number of P&P steps for range 1

certain_percentage.tooltip: Percentage of certain pixels to consider the frame as certain and skip further refinement

uncertainty_threshold.tooltip: Threshold of uncertainty to consider a pixel uncertain

seed.tooltip: Seed for stochastic sampling

latent.tooltip: Optional latent input to get input shape for LTX2 audio/video separation

SamplerSelfRefineVideo.name: SamplerSelfRefineVideo
SamplerSelfRefineVideo.description: Attempt to implement https://github.com/agwmon/self-refine-video, for testing only, MAY NOT WORK AS INTENDED.

audio_path.tooltip: Path to an audio file. Used when audio input is not connected.

duration.tooltip: Duration in seconds to play. 0 = play full audio.

PlaySoundKJ.name: PlaySoundKJ
PlaySoundKJ.description: Plays the input audio in the browser. Modes: 'always' plays on every execution, 'on_empty_queue' plays only when the queue finishes, 'on_change' plays only when the audio content changes. Duration limits playback length (0 = full audio).

CreateInstanceDiffusionTracking.name: CreateInstanceDiffusionTracking
CreateInstanceDiffusionTracking.description:
Creates tracking data to be used with InstanceDiffusion:  
https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-InstanceDiffusion  
  
InstanceDiffusion prompt format:  
"class_id.class_name": "prompt",  
for example:  
"1.head": "((head))",

AppendInstanceDiffusionTracking.name: AppendInstanceDiffusionTracking
AppendInstanceDiffusionTracking.description:
Appends tracking data to be used with InstanceDiffusion:  
https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-InstanceDiffusion

DrawInstanceDiffusionTracking.name: DrawInstanceDiffusionTracking
DrawInstanceDiffusionTracking.description:
Draws the tracking data from  
CreateInstanceDiffusionTracking -node.

finetuned.tooltip: The finetuned model or clip to extract LoRA from.

original.tooltip: The original base model or clip to diff against.

rank.tooltip: The rank to use for standard LoRA, or maximum rank limit for adaptive methods.

algorithm.tooltip: SVD algorithm to use, svd_lowrank is faster but less accurate.

lowrank_iters.tooltip: The number of subspace iterations for lowrank SVD algorithm.

adaptive_param.tooltip: For ratio mode, this is the ratio of the maximum singular value. For quantile mode, this is the quantile of the singular values. For fro mode, this is the Frobenius norm retention ratio.

new_rank.tooltip: The new rank to resize the LoRA. Acts as max rank when using dynamic_method.

dynamic_method.tooltip: Method to use for dynamically determining new alphas and dims. sv_knee finds the elbow point in the singular value curve.

dynamic_param.tooltip: Parameter for dynamic methods. For sv_knee: sensitivity (1.0=standard knee, <1.0=more aggressive/lower rank, >1.0=more conservative).

output_dtype.tooltip: Data type to save the LoRA as.

LoraReduceRankKJ.name: LoraReduceRankKJ
LoraReduceRankKJ.description: Resize a LoRA model by reducing its rank. Based on kohya's sd-scripts: https://github.com/kohya-ss/sd-scripts/blob/main/networks/resize_lora.py

frame_units.tooltip: Units for the frame counts below. 'pixel' converts to latent via ((n - 1) // temporal_downscale) + 1.

dim.tooltip: Latent temporal dimension: 2 for WAN-like, 0 for AnimateDiff-style. Model path only.

temporal_downscale.tooltip: VAE temporal compression for pixel->latent. WAN/Hunyuan/CogVideoX=4, Mochi=6, LTXV=8.

num_frames.tooltip: Total frames to visualize. Ignored on the model path (the real latent length is used).

context_schedule.tooltip: Window placement. standard_static_balanced: static with windows spread evenly (uniform seams, any frame count). batched_shifted: zero-overlap windows whose seams roll each step (~1.0x compute, pairs with freenoise). Uniform schedules also shift per step.

context_stride.tooltip: Max stride power for uniform schedules (adds dilated windows: 1, 2, 4...).

closed_loop.tooltip: Wrap looped-schedule windows around the end back to frame 0.

causal_window_fix.tooltip: Prepend an anchor frame to non-0 windows, stripped after the model call.

freenoise.tooltip: FreeNoise noise shuffling for smoother blending. Model path only.

cond_retain_index_list.tooltip: Comma-separated window-relative indices that keep their original conditioning, e.g. '0' reuses the start frame's cond per window. No viz effect; model path only.

model.tooltip: Optional model to apply the context windows to during sampling.

output_tooltips: Model with context windows applied; only valid when a model is connected.
ContextWindowsVisualizerKJ.name: ContextWindowsVisualizerKJ
ContextWindowsVisualizerKJ.description: Interactive visualization of ComfyUI context windows: window placement, overlap, fuse weights and per-frame blending, updated live. Optionally applies the settings to a model like the core Context Windows (Manual) node.

patch_order.tooltip: Patch the comfy patch_model function to load weight patches (LoRAs) before compiling the model

full_load.tooltip: Disabling may help with memory issues when loading large models, when changing this you should probably force model reload to avoid issues!

PatchModelPatcherOrder.name: PatchModelPatcherOrder
PatchModelPatcherOrder.description: NO LONGER NECESSARY OR FUNCTIONAL, keeping node for backwards compatibility. Use the TorchCompileModelAdvanced to use LoRA with torch.compile.

latent.tooltip: Only used to get the latent count

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning to which guide keyframe info will be added

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning to which guide keyframe info will be added

vae.tooltip: Video VAE used to encode the guide images

latent.tooltip: Video latent, guides are added to the end of this latent

num_guides.tooltip: Select how many guide images to use

output_tooltips: Video latent with added guides
LTXVAddGuideMulti.name: LTXVAddGuideMulti
LTXVAddGuideMulti.description: Add multiple guide images at specified frame indices with strengths, uses DynamicCombo which requires ComfyUI 0.8.1 and frontend 1.33.4 or later.

images.tooltip: Batch of images - non-black images will be used as guides

strength.tooltip: Strength for all guides.

LTXVAddGuidesFromBatch.name: LTXVAddGuidesFromBatch
LTXVAddGuidesFromBatch.description: Adds multiple guide images from a batch to the latent at corresponding frame indices. Non-black images in the batch are used as guides.

video_start_time.tooltip: Start time in seconds for the video mask.

video_end_time.tooltip: End time in seconds for the video mask.

audio_start_time.tooltip: Start time in seconds for the audio mask.

audio_end_time.tooltip: End time in seconds for the audio mask.

max_length.tooltip: 'truncate': cut latent to end_time length. 'pad': extend latent to end_time. 'partial': mask range within existing latent.

existing_mask_mode.tooltip: How to combine with existing noise masks if present. 'add' will take the max of existing and new mask, 'overwrite' will replace with new mask. 'subtract' will set the masked region to 0 instead of 1, effectively unmasking it.

LTXVAudioVideoMask.name: LTXVAudioVideoMask
LTXVAudioVideoMask.description: Creates noise masks for video and audio latents based on specified time ranges. New content is generated within these masked regions

nag_alpha.tooltip: Mixing coefficient in that controls the balance between the normalized guided representation and the original positive representation.

nag_tau.tooltip: Clipping threshold that controls how much the guided attention can deviate from the positive attention.

inplace.tooltip: If true, modifies tensors in place to save memory. Leads to different numerical results which may change the output slightly.

chunks.tooltip: Number of chunks to split the feedforward activations into to reduce peak VRAM usage.

dim_threshold.tooltip: Dimension threshold above which to apply chunking.

LTXVChunkFeedForward.name: LTXVChunkFeedForward
LTXVChunkFeedForward.description: EXPERIMENTAL AND MAY CHANGE THE MODEL OUTPUT!! Chunks feedforward activations to reduce peak VRAM usage.

model.tooltip: The model to add preview override to.

latent_upscale_model.tooltip: Optional upscale model to use for higher resolution previews.

LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride.description: Overrides the LTX2 preview sampling preview function, temporary measure until previews are in comfy core

model.tooltip: The model to add preview override to.

audio_normalization_factors.tooltip: Comma-separated list of audio normalization factors to apply at each sampling step. For example, '1,1,0.25,1,1,0.25,1,1' will apply a factor of 0.25 at the 3rd and 6th steps.

output_tooltips: The model with Audio Latent Normalizing Sampling.

LTXVImgToVideoInplaceKJ.name: LTXVImgToVideoInplaceKJ
LTXVImgToVideoInplaceKJ.description: Replaces video latent frames with the encoded input images, uses DynamicCombo which requires ComfyUI 0.8.1 and frontend 1.33.4 or later.

blocks.tooltip: Comma separated list of transformer block indices to apply the patch to. Leave empty to apply to all blocks.

triton_kernels.tooltip: Use Triton fused kernels for norm+scale+shift and rope application operations, can be very slightly faster.

LTX2AttentionTunerPatch.name: LTX2AttentionTunerPatch
LTX2AttentionTunerPatch.description: EXPERIMENTAL! Custom LTX2 forward pass with attention scaling factors per modality, also reduces peak VRAM usage.

triton_kernels.tooltip: Use Triton fused RoPE kernel on the self-attention Q/K. Requires Triton.

LTX2MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch.name: LTX2MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch
LTX2MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch.display_name: LTX2 Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch
LTX2MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch.description: EXPERIMENTAL! Activates custom sageattention to reduce peak VRAM usage, overrides the attention mode. Requires latest sageattention version.

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

video.tooltip: Strength for video attention layers.

video_to_audio.tooltip: Strength for video to audio cross-attention layers.

audio.tooltip: Strength for audio attention layers.

audio_to_video.tooltip: Strength for audio to video cross-attention layers.

other.tooltip: Strength for layers not caught by other layer filters.

output_tooltips: The modified diffusion model.

LTX2LoraLoaderAdvanced.name: LTX2LoraLoaderAdvanced
LTX2LoraLoaderAdvanced.description: Advanced LoRA loader with per-block strength control for LTX2 models

WanVideoMemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatc.name: WanVideoMemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch
WanVideoMemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatc.display_name: WanVideo Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch
WanVideoMemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatc.description: EXPERIMENTAL! Activates custom sageattention on the WanVideo self-attention to reduce peak VRAM usage, overrides the attention mode. Requires latest sageattention version.

fuse_norm_silu.tooltip: Replace norm+SiLU chains (RMSNorm for Wan, GroupNorm for KL VAEs) with fused Triton kernels (single pass, fp32 accumulation). Requires triton.

channels_last.tooltip: Convert conv weights to channels_last memory format, removing cuDNN layout transposes around every conv. Required for the fused GroupNorm kernel to engage on KL VAEs.

int8_conv.tooltip: EXPERIMENTAL: run the VAE decoder's 3x3 convolutions on int8 tensor cores (4x the bf16 rate on Ada+). Weights quantized per-out-channel, activations dynamically per-tensor; ~45-48 dB vs the bf16 decode, minor quality loss possible. Wan 2.1/2.2 and KL image VAEs (Flux2/SDXL/SD1.5), ignored for others.

autotune.tooltip: Benchmark several kernel block-size configs on first use of each tensor shape and cache the fastest. Brief stutter per new resolution, usually a few percent faster after warmup.

PatchTritonVAE.name: PatchTritonVAE
PatchTritonVAE.description: Speeds up VAE decode/encode with fused Triton norm+SiLU kernels and channels_last conv layout. Supported VAEs (auto-detected): Wan 2.1/2.2 video VAEs incl. Qwen-Image (RMSNorm, ~1.4x/1.15x), KL image VAEs such as Flux/Flux2, SDXL and SD1.5 (GroupNorm, ~1.6-1.8x at 2048px), and LTXV/LTX2 video VAEs (PixelNorm; timestep-conditioned decoder blocks get norm-only fusion). Other architectures are not supported. Applied as object patches on a cloned patcher, so it only exists while this VAE is loaded.

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

LoraLoader|pysssss.name: LoraLoader|pysssss
LoraLoader|pysssss.description: This LoRA loader is used to modify both diffusion and CLIP models, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.
output_tooltips: The modified diffusion model.
The modified CLIP model.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

CheckpointLoader|pysssss.description: Loads a diffusion model checkpoint, diffusion models are used to denoise latents.

The VAE model used for encoding and decoding images to and from latent space.

UnloadCPUModels.name: UnloadCPUModels
UnloadCPUModels.description: Frees CPU-resident models such as the text encoder, which ComfyUI's VRAM pressure never evicts. Passes its input through unchanged.

keep.tooltip: Comma-separated substrings of class names to keep loaded. Case-insensitive. The VAE runs next, so keep it.

UnloadAfterSampling.name: UnloadAfterSampling
UnloadAfterSampling.description: Frees the diffusion model after sampling so the VAE has room to decode. Passes its input through unchanged.
